title: Palisades (Holtec restart): External_Sender Comment Re. Emergency License Amendment Request: One-Time-Use Amendment to Allow Alternative Fuel Handling Method for the Recovery of Fuel Assembly DD41 [['E-Mail']]

documents.text:
From:           Leigh Ford
To:             Marlayna Doell
Subject:        [External_Sender] Comment Re. Emergency License Amendment Request: One-Time-Use Amendment to Allow
                Alternative Fuel Handling Method for the Recovery of Fuel Assembly DD41
Date:           Thursday, October 8, 2026 2:57:56 PM


Greetings, Ms. Doell.

We urge the Nuclear Regulatory Commission to deny Holtec's
"Emergency License Amendment Request" to allow an alternative fuel
handling method at Palisades.

Holtec's accident while loading fuel rods needs to be addressed before any
work continues, and the community needs to be fully informed and given
time to comment. Experts, let alone the public, need more time than 44
hours to consider the risks of this amendment to workers and the
community, and to return substantive comments.

If communities are to accept nuclear energy, transparency is key and we
need our regulators to be on the side of communities.

Please deny the amendment request and open up a longer comment
period with time for sufficient community outreach.

Thank you for your consideration,

Leigh Ford



Leigh Ford (she/her)

Executive Director

Snake River Alliance

On Shoshone, Northern Paiute, and Bannock land

(208) 344-9161 (office)

snakeriveralliance.org
